citation: Tao Huan, Hua Fang, Chen Yingying, et al. Metagenomic Next-Generation Sequencing (mNGS) for the Timely Diagnosis of Carbapenem-Resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae Infection in Leukemia Patients: A Report of Two Cases. Case Reports in Infectious Diseases, 2022.

population.population_description: Two adult leukemia patients with febrile neutropenia after chemotherapy and carbapenem-resistant K. pneumoniae (CrKP) bacteremia diagnosed by mNGS
population.haemato_subtypes: 1 acute myelogenous leukemia (24-year-old man), 1 acute monocytic leukemia (54-year-old man)

neutropenic_status: Febrile neutropenia after first chemotherapy in both; case 1 WBC 0.16 x 10^9/L, neutrophil count 0
reference_standard: Blood culture (case 2: CrKP grew 4 days after mNGS) and clinical response; stool cultures showed CrKP colonization

diagnostic_yield.basis: Case 2 blood mNGS positive K. pneumoniae 225 unique reads at 16 h; case 1 CrKP bacteremia confirmed via stool culture/blood culture per narrative; CSF mNGS detected Aspergillus flavus (62 reads) and CMV (218 reads) with negative culture

additional_yield_vs_conventional: In case 2, mNGS revealed K. pneumoniae after 16 hours while blood culture showed CrKP after 4 days; CSF mNGS detected A. flavus and CMV while 'the culture was negative'
therapy_change: Zavicefta (ceftazidime-avibactam) given immediately based on mNGS; voriconazole started for intracranial fungal infection
mortality_or_outcomes: Both patients improved ('After treatment, the patient's body temperature and blood pressure returned to normal'; headache relieved)
quadas2_notes: n=2; anecdotal; no denominators; QUADAS-2 not applicable for pooling.

evidence_quotes.quote: Herein, we report two leukemia patients who developed severe infections due to carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae (CrKP).
Sixteen hours later, mNGS revealed the presence of K. pneumoniae (225 unique reads) without drug resistance genes.
In case 2, the mNGS test revealed the presence of K. pneumoniae after 16 hours while blood culture showed CrKP after 4 days.
Cerebrospinal fluid was detected by mNGS, and Aspergillus flavus (62 unique reads) and cytomegalovirus (218 unique reads) were detected, while the culture was negative.
After treatment, the patient's body temperature and blood pressure returned to normal.

exclusion_reason: Case report (n=2 patients); no 2x2, no denominator.
